name: Checkstand lane bank — the ONLY seal zone this guide needs. Tight to the drawn registers (fixtures span x 446.7-819.7, y 616.6-661.4) so the lanes close while the front action alley (y>665), the corridor north of the bank (y<613) and both end-of-bank walkways (x~442 west, x>822 east) stay open; bridge 20 because checkout lanes are wider than service-counter gaps. The auto-derived rect ran y 608.6-730.0 (CHECK_WIN_Y swept in the vestibule/lease-room boxes) and swallowed the whole front band, which then survived as one badge-protected 5990-cell pocket — i.e. nothing was sealed at all. NOTE on the omitted service disks: store 57's guide draws Deli+Bakery, Seafood and Pharmacy as fully walled enclosures, so each is already an unreachable pocket without any disk; the derived 130-pt disks reached far past those walls and bridged real shopping corridors shut (DELI's disk sealed the Toys/School/Fishing gondola aisles at x 804-834, BAKERY's sealed the Apparel floor and the Fishing/Bakery-west corridor, FLORAL's sealed the Greeting-Cards aisle ends). Pharmacy is handled by an exclusion poly traced from its drawn walls instead.
